program.name: Mobility 35
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of mobility: a joint flow, then a control circuit.
program.about: Mobility for about half an hour. A flow through the hips, spine and shoulders, then a circuit of slow control moves, then a few stretches. Two sessions alternate, so the joints worked change. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Joint flow & control A / B, 35 minutes
